name: ai-marketplace
description: AI-first marketplace: chat is the primary interface for buyers and sellers, and every marketplace action is also exposed to external agents over MCP.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
